scientific_question: Inside the fixed six-direction S2 family inherited from v51, does a fully pre-fixed truth-feasible finite roster contain any complete frozen-v40 gate witness?

frozen_parent_evidence.v43_role: Direct-K3, Direct-K4 and Zero reference metrics plus the four-direction diagnostic anchor
frozen_parent_evidence.v44_role: validated first curved-adjoint direction and five-direction anchor
frozen_parent_evidence.v50_role: independently replayed 2304-request fixed-roster negative and its best diagnostic anchor
frozen_parent_evidence.v51_role: independently replayed fixed-linearization second residual-adjoint direction, S5 and S6 selected weights

direction_reconstruction.direct_prediction: validated v51 Stage-A direct_prediction.npy; no curved forward is allowed during roster construction
direction_reconstruction.directions_1_to_4: regenerate the four frozen straight-CGLS coarse increments from y-direct_prediction, then prolong with the frozen geometry

truth_feasibility.field_limit: min(1.01 * Direct-K4 field relative-L2, Zero field relative-L2)
truth_feasibility.gradient_limit: min(1.01 * Direct-K4 gradient relative-L2, Zero gradient relative-L2)
truth_feasibility.constraint_form: exact affine-subspace quadratic field and coarse-gradient residual norms

sobol.mapping: 2*u-1, discard exact zero vectors, normalize by L-infinity norm

local.anchor: v51 S6 weights radially mapped from the origin into truth feasibility, then multiplied by 0.99

anchors.mapping: radially map each frozen historical weight from the origin into the same box and truth-feasible set
members_in_request_order: v43 four-direction anchor padded with two zeros
v44 five-direction anchor padded with one zero
v47 five-direction anchor padded with one zero
v50 best diagnostic five-direction anchor padded with one zero
v51 S5 weights padded with one zero
v51 S6 weights with w6 set to zero

request_order: all global directions in Sobol order and radial-fraction order
all local directions in Sobol order, negative then positive sign, and step-fraction order
all eight anchors in the listed order

complete_gate.within_1p01_of_direct_k4: field, gradient and observation relative-L2 ratios must all be <= 1.01
complete_gate.no_worse_than_zero: field, gradient and observation relative-L2 ratios must all be <= 1.0
numeric_margin_members: (Direct-K3 observation minus candidate observation) divided by Direct-K3 observation

decision_rules.robust_witness: at least one complete-gate candidate has minimum numeric margin >= 0.001
decision_rules.fragile_witness: at least one complete-gate candidate exists but no passing candidate has minimum numeric margin >= 0.001
decision_rules.bounded_negative: all 2312 requests are independently replayed and none passes the complete gate

required_independent_validation: validator must not import the v52 runner
reverify the clean tracked source commit, source closure and frozen parent evidence
independently reconstruct all six fixed directions
independently rebuild the field and gradient truth-constraint model
independently regenerate all 2312 requests in the same order
verify the pre-forward roster seal and that roster bytes remain unchanged
independently execute exactly 2312 curved forwards and recompute every metric, gate, margin and final decision
verify the runner report bytes remain unchanged before and after replay

claim_boundary.a_robust_witness_would_show: finite-roster representation headroom inside this fixed S2 six-space and would redirect work toward the observation-only selector
claim_boundary.a_fragile_witness_would_show: numerically narrow finite-roster headroom requiring a new frozen robustness test
claim_boundary.a_negative_result_would_show: no witness among this pre-fixed 2312-request truth-feasible roster
claim_boundary.a_negative_result_would_not_prove: continuous six-dimensional nonexistence or global mathematical impossibility
claim_boundary.shared_kernel_limitation: runner and validator are separate implementations but share the frozen v42 truth-margin class and v44 curved-forward, geometry and basis numerical kernels
claim_boundary.historical_same_snapshot_observation_dep: the local roster is centered on the previously selected v51 S6 point; v52 forbids result-after adaptation but is not observation-independent
